verdict.rationale: Oneleet ships automation surfaces: service keys for AI agent automation and scripts, an MCP server, and Fieldwork AI agents that collect evidence on a schedule. So versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair axis for this product. The pack has no evidence of versioning, review workflows, or rollback for any of these automations. The draft-and-publish flow and review history it does mention apply to policies and controls, not automations.
